title: A novel role of Nano selenium and sildenafil on streptozotocin-induced diabetic nephropathy in rats by modulation of inflammatory, oxidative, and apoptotic pathways.
authors: El-Azab, Mona F; Al-Karmalawy, Ahmed A; Antar, Samar A; Hanna, Pierre A; Tawfik, Karim M; Hazem, Reem M
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨纳米硒和西地那非对糖尿病肾病大鼠的炎症、氧化应激和凋亡通路的影响，仅用分子对接评估药物与HMGB1结合，核心是疾病药理而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: AIMS: The present study aimed to investigate the effect of nano selenium, sildenafil, and their combination on inflammation, oxidative stress, and apoptosis in streptozotocin-induced diabetic nephropathy in rats. Herein, a new anti-inflammatory pathway for sildenafil as a high-mobility group box (HMGB1) inhibitor was proposed using the molecular docking technique. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Rats were divided into 7 groups: normal control, control nano selenium, control sildenafil, control diabetic, diabetic+ nano selenium, diabetic+ sildenafil, diabetic+ nano selenium+ sildenafil. The effects of drugs were evaluated by measuring serum urea, creatinine, lactate dehydrogenase (LDH), levels of tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), Interleukin 1 beta (IL-1beta), HMGB1, receptor advanced glycation end product (RAGE), malondialdehyde (MDA), thioredoxin reductase (TrxR) by biochemical assays, nuclear factor-kappa b (NF-kappaB), toll-like receptor (TLR4) by immunohistochemistry, gene expressions of caspase 3 and monocyte chemoattractant protein (MCP-1) besides histopathological investigations of renal cells. KEY FINDINGS: Results showed beneficial effects of 8 weeks of treatment by nano selenium and sildenafil supported by improvement in kidney function, histopathological changes, and reduction in all of these parameters. These results supported molecular docking that indicated sildenafil had a high binding score and interactions with the HMGB1 receptor. SIGNIFICANCE: The current study demonstrated a renoprotective effect of nano‑selenium and sildenafil by interfering at multiple pathways, especially the HMGB1/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在探讨纳米硒、西地那非及其联合用药对链脲佐菌素诱导的糖尿病肾病大鼠炎症、氧化应激和凋亡的影响。在此，通过分子对接技术提出了西地那非作为高迁移率族蛋白盒1（HMGB1）抑制剂的新型抗炎通路。材料与方法：将大鼠分为7组：正常对照组、纳米硒对照组、西地那非对照组、糖尿病对照组、糖尿病+纳米硒组、糖尿病+西地那非组、糖尿病+纳米硒+西地那非组。通过生化检测测定血清尿素、肌酐、乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）、白细胞介素1β（IL-1β）、HMGB1、晚期糖基化终末产物受体（RAGE）、丙二醛（MDA）、硫氧还蛋白还原酶（TrxR）水平，通过免疫组化检测核因子-κB（NF-κB）、Toll样受体（TLR4），通过基因表达检测caspase 3和单核细胞趋化蛋白（MCP-1），并进行肾细胞组织病理学检查，以评估药物效果。主要发现：结果显示，纳米硒和西地那非治疗8周具有有益效果，表现为肾功能改善、组织病理学变化减轻以及所有上述参数降低。这些结果支持了分子对接的结论，即西地那非与HMGB1受体具有高结合评分和相互作用。意义：本研究证明纳米硒和西地那非通过干扰多条通路，特别是HMGB1/NF-κB信号通路，发挥肾脏保护作用。
